title: Chapter 1429 - 8: Perfected Fleshly Body (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 1429 - 8: Perfected Fleshly Body (Part 2)

Chapter 1429 - 8: Perfected Fleshly Body (Part 2)

"What is so special about the Chaos Void that a powerhouse like the Galaxy Lord would pay such a tragic price to merge into it?" The Mother of the Screw Realm shook her head and said.

The First Realm and Second Realm beings of time are very interested in comprehending the operation of the Origin Dao of different dimensional spaces, but the Time Lords? What the Lords pursue is the path of transcendence. Unless it's some special dimensional space, normal dimensional spaces find it difficult to attract the Lords' attention.

Let alone paying a tragic price to merge into it.

"This..."

Wan Chengkong also didn't know how to explain.

"Regardless of whether the Galaxy Lord was originally a Lord or reached the Lord level in this cycle of Great Destruction, it's beyond our speculation."

The Mother of the Screw Realm said.

"Indeed."

Wan Chengkong nodded.

Even a strong being like Lord Chu Wei is trembling in front of the Galaxy Lord, let alone them.

"Those beings of time in the Chaos Void, they really have good luck..." Wan Chengkong sighed and said.

They too came from a top-tier dimensional space as beings of time, but after their home dimension was destroyed, they ventured into dimensional gaps, wandering everywhere, experiencing many calamities, to finally achieve what they have now.

And those beings of time in the Chaos Void...although they have not yet left their home dimensional space, it is foreseeable that with the protection of the Galaxy Lord, their future path of cultivation will be smoother by a thousand-fold compared to them.

"Indeed."

The Mother of the Screw Realm sighed.

...

The Third Origin World.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, observing the virtual world not far away.

"Still too far, need to get a bit closer."

Lin Yuan got up and contacted the Three-Life Immortal Emperor and the other two Immortal Emperors.

"Tianyuan, are you saying that we should join forces to go deeper into the virtual world?" The Three-Life Immortal Emperor's expression was slightly grave.

The other two Immortal Emperors also looked solemn: "Tianyuan, this virtual world has a significant background, definitely related to a legendary level Lord. Even now, the pressure we are bearing is enormous."

The three Immortal Emperors, plus Lin Yuan, total four, positioned extremely close to the virtual world, while those Red Dust Immortals and Immortal Kings were much farther away from the virtual world.

The main reason is that the Red Dust Immortals and Immortal Kings cannot withstand the pressure brought by the extremely close proximity to the virtual world.

Everyone knows that the closer you get to the virtual world, the more you are affected, but you also have to be able to get close.

"No problem, I've recently had a breakthrough in power, and I can give it a try."

Lin Yuan said.

He didn't dare to venture deeper into the virtual world alone, bringing the Three-Life Immortal Emperor and other Lords along so they could take care of each other in case of danger.

"A breakthrough?"

Immortal Emperor Dao You looked at Lin Yuan with a slightly puzzled expression.

"Then let's start preparing."

Emperor Wu Yu said.

He didn't believe teaming up would allow them to venture much deeper into the virtual world.

Currently, they were already at their limits, and going deeper required more than just a power breakthrough.

But since Lin Yuan suggested it, they might as well try, letting Lin Yuan realize the difference is beneficial too.

Rumbling——

Soon, Lin Yuan decisively took action and ventured into the virtual world.

The overwhelming pressure force swept over, even the Chaotic Origin Dao would collapse, but Lin Yuan, using the power of Tai Chu, caused the endless binding pressure to dissipate the moment it approached.

"This?"

Immortal Emperor Dao You widened his eyes.

"Immediately follow."

Seeing this, the Three-Life Immortal Emperor acted without hesitation.

Emperor Wu Yu did the same, and Immortal Emperor Dao You quickly reacted.

The three Immortal Emperors and Lin Yuan joined forces, continuously approaching the virtual world, stopping only when they were about to reach the membrane wall of the virtual world, faintly seeing the chaotic scenes inside.

"Tianyuan, your strength?"

After settling down a bit, Immortal Emperor Dao You's tone was somewhat incredulous.

Earlier, while approaching the virtual world, mainly Lin Yuan and the Three-Life Immortal Emperor bore most of the pressure.

As for Emperor Wu Yu and himself, Immortal Emperor Dao You? They basically breezed through, the pressure they carried together was not even a tenth of what Lin Yuan endured.

"Tianyuan, you've been too modest." The Three-Life Immortal Emperor remarked: "Even I might not be your opponent now."

Although they hadn't directly sparred with Lin Yuan, from the pressure both bore while approaching the virtual world, the Three-Life Immortal Emperor was sure Lin Yuan was not much weaker than himself.

Immortal Emperor Dao You and Emperor Wu Yu exchanged glances, both feeling inexplicably shocked.

They had intended to advise Lin Yuan about the difficulty of getting close to the virtual world.

And now?

"How do you feel now?"

Lin Yuan looked at the virtual world close at hand.

"Very good."

The Three-Life Immortal Emperor nodded.

"If not for you, Tianyuan, we wouldn't know how long it would take to get this close."

Immortal Emperor Dao You couldn't help but say that, by their estimation, only a substantial power boost for the Three-Life Immortal Emperor or them both reaching the level of the Three-Life Immortal Emperor could achieve it.

Lin Yuan smiled without saying much.

"What is the background of this virtual world?" Lin Yuan looked at the Three-Life Immortal Emperor and asked.

The virtual world was not an object of the Great Wilderness Origin World but fell into it from the vast dimensional gap.

"I'm not sure."

The Three-Life Immortal Emperor shook his head. When the virtual world fell into the Great Wilderness Origin World, he had just entered the Red Dust Immortal Realm, becoming a being of time not long ago, only sensing the entire world tremble, and later vaguely detecting the presence of immortal material.

"Given your cultivation speed, Tianyuan, figuring out the origin of this virtual world is just a matter of time."

Immortal Emperor Dao You said from the side, having witnessed Lin Yuan's rapid growth firsthand; not long ago, Lin Yuan had just entered the Second Realm, and now he's already reaching or even surpassing the Three-Life Immortal Emperor.

"I feel it might not be that simple."

Lin Yuan stared at the virtual world, feeling an overwhelming sense of oppression, more so than even Wanwei Space-Time.

...

Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan looked at the Seven-God Treasure Tree before him.

After the Taiji Primordial Spirit obtained this rare artifact, it was immediately sent out, and only now did it reach Lin Yuan's true body.

With danger lurking in Wanwei Space-Time, if Lin Yuan had only obtained ordinary treasures, they might not have been sent out so quickly, but something as valuable as the Seven-God Treasure Tree, worth millions of pounds of the Sands of Time?

It would definitely be sent to the true body as quickly as possible to 'secure it'.

If it remained with the Taiji Primordial Spirit, who knows what might happen.

The Taiji Primordial Spirit still faces the possibility of falling within Wanwei Space-Time.

"The Seven-God Treasure Tree!"

Lin Yuan observed the aura of this rare treasure, sensing the peculiar energy it nurtured inside, mysteriously attracting the physical body.

"So magical."

Lin Yuan suppressed the body's desire and continued observing the Seven-God Treasure Tree.

Lin Yuan had originally thought his body was already flawless enough, even if not reaching a perfect body, it wasn't far off.

But now, sensing the strange aura inside the Seven-God Treasure Tree, he realized there was still a long way to go to achieve a truly perfect body.

Not to mention reaching a perfect body, Lin Yuan was far from attaining a near-perfect body level.

This perfection is not just about the degree of strength but a deeper level of perfection.

"The Lord Wanwei, he probably not only achieved the 'perfect soul' level but most likely the 'perfect body' level as well." Lin Yuan thought to himself.

It's just that because Lord Wanwei was not the first to reach the 'perfect body' level, the outside world was unaware.

"Although the 'perfect body' has been proven unable to transcend, it certainly enhances one's strength, and for me, the more, the better."

Lin Yuan first observed many future timelines, ensuring that the Seven-God Treasure Tree would not pose any hidden dangers to him, and then began absorbing it immediately.

Buzzing~ As the strange force entered Lin Yuan's body, it merged into every micro-particle.

Currently, every micro-particle in Lin Yuan's body is composed of thirty-three basic units, nurturing a vast particle world.

The integration of the strange force from the Seven-God Treasure Tree immediately began transforming every particle within Lin Yuan's body, rapidly advancing towards a higher level.
